findings.quoted_text: Client may terminate this Agreement at any time, without notice and without further payment.
All intellectual property rights in each Deliverable transfer to Client upon delivery.
Client may terminate this Agreement at any time, without notice and without further payment.
findings.explanation: This clause allows the client to terminate the contract instantly without notice and without paying for work performed, leaving you uncompensated for your time and effort.
findings.suggested_change: Require advance written notice and mandate payment for all services rendered and expenses incurred up to the date of termination.

findings.quoted_text: All intellectual property rights in each Deliverable transfer to Client upon delivery.
findings.explanation: Intellectual property transfers immediately upon delivery, which occurs prior to full payment being received (especially under Net 30 terms), removing your leverage if payment is delayed or withheld.
findings.suggested_change: Specify that all intellectual property rights transfer to the client only upon receipt of full payment for the respective deliverables.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, thank you for sending over the agreement. I have reviewed it and would like to propose a couple of adjustments before signing: - The relevant clause regarding termination allows ending the agreement without notice and without paying for work performed; I propose we require advance written notice and mandate payment for all services rendered and expenses incurred up to the date of termination. - The relevant clause regarding intellectual property transfers rights upon delivery before full payment is received; I propose we specify that all intellectual property rights transfer to the client only upon receipt of full payment for the respective deliverables. Thank you and best regards,
